Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you need my date of birth as well?

I’ve turned mobile data on now. The top of my phone still says 2G, and I see something about “Data Saver” as well. Is that okay? I really want to make sure I get excellent internet speed—what should I do next?

It looks like my phone is set to use only 2G. How do I change it to something faster, like 4G or 5G? I really want to make sure I get the best internet speed possible.

I turned off the VPN, but I still can’t get any internet connection—it keeps saying there’s no connection when I try to test the speed. What else can I try? I really need my internet to be excellent, not just working a little bit.

I checked, and my APN name says “internet” and there’s something about an MMSC URL. I don’t really know what any of that means. Should I still reset the APN settings and reboot my phone, or is there something else I should try first? I just want to make sure I don’t mess anything up.

I reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone, but I still can’t get any internet connection—it keeps saying there’s no connection when I try to test the speed. I’m really getting worried now. Is there anything else we can try? I really need my internet to be excellent.

I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my phone’s internet to work perfectly. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?
At the top of my phone’s screen, I see an airplane icon and something that looks like a lock. I don’t see any signal bars or anything about 4G or 5G. What does this mean? Is that bad?

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see some signal bars, and it says 2G at the top, but I also see something about data being disabled. What should I do next? I still want to make sure I get excellent internet speed.

I’ve turned on mobile data now. The top of my screen still says 2G, and I see something about “Data Saver” as well. Is that okay? I really want to make sure I get the best internet speed possible. What should I do next?

I’ve changed the network mode to prefer 4G and 5G, and I’ve also turned off Data Saver mode. Now the top of my screen says 5G and the signal looks excellent. Is there anything else I should do to make sure my internet speed is the best it can be?

Oh, I tried to check my internet speed, but it says there’s no connection. Even though it shows 5G and excellent signal at the top, it seems like the internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

I checked my APN settings, and it says the APN name is "internet" and there’s something about an MMSC URL for picture messages. I’m not sure what any of that means. Should I reset these settings, or is there something else I should do? I just want to make sure I get excellent internet speed.

I reset the APN settings and restarted my phone, but when I tried to check the internet speed again, it still says there’s no connection. I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why isn’t this working even though it shows 5G and excellent signal at the top? What else can I do to get excellent internet speed?

Oh, I see! That explains why nothing is working. Yes, please, I’d like to add 2 GB of data so I can get my internet back. I really hope this will finally give me excellent speed. Can you help me with that?

I restarted my phone like you said, but when I tried to check the internet speed again, it still says there’s no connection. I’m really getting worried now—why isn’t it working even after adding more data? I just want excellent internet speed. What should I do next?
Yes, please transfer me to a human agent. I really need this fixed so I can have excellent internet speed. Thank you for your help so far.
